Suvrankar Datta

Physician-scientist · Clinical AI evaluation and safety · Radiology · Global health

EmailLinkedInGoogle Scholar
pageBodyHtml:
Public version. This concise HTML CV excludes private information and application-only material. Use your browser’s Print command to save a PDF.

Current roles

  • Simons Ashoka Early Career Fellow, Koita Centre for Digital Health, Ashoka University.
  • Founder and Group Lead, CRASH Lab (Centre for Responsible Autonomous Systems in Healthcare).

Clinical training

  • MD, Radiodiagnosis & Interventional Radiology, AIIMS New Delhi.
  • Senior Residency, Radiodiagnosis & Interventional Radiology, AIIMS New Delhi.
  • MBBS, JIPMER — Gold Medallist.

Selected programmes

  • Radiology's Last Exam: co-first author, RadLE 1.0; co-lead, RadLE 2.0.
  • Equitable radiology foundation models: Principal Investigator, DST–A*STAR India–Singapore programme.
  • PREDICT-AI: Principal Investigator, IndiaAI CATCH consortium with Tata Memorial Hospital and Manentia AI.
  • PrAImaan: Clinical Research and Technical Teams Supervisor under PI Prof. Anurag Agrawal.
  • V2DD: Clinical Evaluation Team Supervisor under PI Prof. Anurag Agrawal.

Selected publications

  • Zhou HY, Acosta JN, Adithan S, Datta S, Topol EJ, Rajpurkar P. MedVersa: a generalist foundation model for diverse medical imaging tasks. NEJM AI. 2026. DOI →
  • Datta S*, Buchireddygari D*, et al. Radiology's Last Exam (RadLE). 2025. Preprint →
  • Pate S, Farooq A, Datta S, et al. Fine-grained rib fracture diagnosis with hyperbolic embeddings. MICCAI. 2025. DOI →
